verdict.rationale: Otter's docs say AI Chat searches across your meetings and connected apps to answer questions (otter-docs-1), and that it finds insights from past calls in natural language (otter-docs-11). The MCP route extends this with search across all time periods and pattern analysis across meetings (otter-docs-18, otter-docs-34). Missing for 10: no evidence that answers cite or link back to specific source meetings or transcript passages, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-history Q&A quality.
